scope: L1 byte-materialization mechanics to L3 request/scheduler/lifecycle handoff
window_size_policy: Every 0x400 window is acquisition coverage only. It is not an asserted function body size or semantic boundary.
non_claims: no generic child or outstanding-work fan-in counter is asserted
scheduler pending-entry rollback is not relabeled as OS AsyncIO cancellation
LoadedResource state publication is L3 lifecycle authority, not L1 byte-materialization ownership
successful byte-window acquisition alone does not prove semantic equivalence
no original-process or Level-E receipt is produced by this plan

windows.purpose: Reacquire the whole-file materialization load-state constructor and the boundary between selected resource opening, byte-read mechanics and lifecycle-owned request state.
Reacquire caller-owned-destination transfer submission and exact submit-failure/status behavior without conflating byte mechanics with request ownership.
Reacquire callback(ticketId,userContext,errorFlag,bytesRead), byte-progress/status writes and its relationship to L3 request/completion ownership.
Reacquire ReadRequest/FileSlot submission mechanics and separate physical byte-read behavior from L3 request ownership/scheduling.
Reacquire pending scheduled-entry clear/rollback, queue matching and exact ordering. This is scheduler rollback evidence and must not be relabeled as OS-level AsyncIO cancellation.

Close the materialization submission/scheduling wrapper body, callees and inherited load-context consumption; determine exactly where L1 byte-materialization mechanics hand off to L3 request/scheduler ownership.
Reacquire scheduler-ring enqueue metadata, callback/context writes, ring advancement and ordering relative to materialization submission and LoadedResource completion.
Reacquire scheduler worker callback execution and slot-clear ordering to establish the L3 lifecycle completion barrier without presupposing a generic fan-in counter.
Reacquire exact L3 cancellation sequence around scheduler rollback, state1/state2 to state4 writes and deferred cleanup enqueue.
Reacquire acquisition construction, materialization-dispatch success gate, state0 to state1 publication and completion-callback registration ordering.
Reacquire loose-container child submission/recursive in-place synthesis and determine the exact materialization-to-lifecycle completion dependency without assuming a child counter.
Reacquire the explicit L1/L3 seam: materialization mechanics and return semantics whose success gates L3 state1 publication.
Reacquire the L3 normal completion callback, record-context decoding and exact conditions for state1 to state2 publication; this is not raw byte-read ownership.
Reacquire deferred state4 cleanup and backing-release ordering to close the cancellation side of the lifecycle boundary.
